beats.text: Five Stoic ways to stop caring what other people think.
One. Most people aren't judging you. They're too busy worrying what you think of them.
Two. You don't control opinions — only your character. Tend the part that's actually yours.
Three. Ask: would I take life advice from this person? If not, why take their judgement?
Four. Everyone whose approval you crave will one day be forgotten — and so will you. Act freely.
Five. The only audience that lasts is the person you're slowly becoming.
Care less about being seen as good, said the Stoics, and more about simply being it.
